text:
alex: FYI pushed a kernel-selector tweak and seeing ~20% tail-latency regression on 8-GPU TP+PP runs. NSight capture here: https://perf.redwood/nscap/9a8b
maria: which config? TP/PP split, batch, seq len?
alex: tp=2 pp=4, batch=4 (microbatches), seq=1024, quant=4bit. Selector picked `fused_ffn_v2` across MLPs. Timeline shows larger gaps around all-reduce phases.
siva: can you trigger nvprof + our custom timers? need `allreduce_queue_ns` and `kv_cache_wait_ns` traces.
perf-bot: nvprof capture queued on worker-gpu-12 for 2026-03-17T10:22Z. Logs/trace will land in /s3/perf-captures/9a8b/
kai: my 2c: if selector prefers higher-throughput kernels that increase single-kernel latency, we lose overlap. That can increase allreduce queueing if we reduce the number of overlapping ops.
alex: pasted a tiny timeline excerpt:
```
GPU0: attention (12.3ms) -> gap (1.2ms) -> fused_ffn_v2 (18.7ms) -> allreduce wait (3.4ms) -> memcpy H2D (0.6ms)
GPU1: attention (12.1ms) -> gap (1.1ms) -> fused_ffn_v2 (19.0ms) -> allreduce wait (3.5ms) -> memcpy H2D (0.6ms)
```
maria: try env toggles: `RUNTIME_KERNEL_PREF=overlap` and `KV_CACHE_PREFETCH=1` for the rerun. also enable per-microbatch timers in /metrics/runtime/parallel_eff.
siva: adding the timer names to the tracer: `kernel_exec_ns`, `allreduce_queue_ns`, `kv_cache_wait_ns`, `h2d_ms`, `d2h_ms` — log at microbatch granularity.
alex: ran with timers. summary:
- before: kv_cache_wait_ns median=1.2ms, allreduce_queue_ns median=0.5ms
- after selector change: kv_cache_wait_ns median=2.8ms, allreduce_queue_ns median=3.3ms
kai: that matches the hypothesis — kernels longer -> less opportunity to overlap reduce -> queue growth. Also check per-layer KV cache hotpaths; maybe prefetch ordering changed.
maria: can we A/B canary the selector to 50%? collect nsight+nvprof for both arms and batch-size histogram. batching heuristic may be grouping microbatches differently under the new selector.
alex: scheduling A/B. plan:
1) Canary v2 (selector new) at 50% traffic
2) Nsight capture + nvprof + tracer enabled
3) Export prometheus histograms: `runtime_parallel_batch_size` and `kv_cache_latency_bucket`
4) Collect for 30 min under steady qps

siva: also record `nccl_allreduce_bytes` and `nccl_launch_wait_ns` per-GPU. we need to see if NCCL is parking or if CPU thread serialization is the issue.
maria: don't forget to capture `/proc/interrupts` and CPU isol cpuset for the capture nodes — CPU scheduling can screw up overlap.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout (kernel-selector-v2) started -> 50% traffic to worker pool: inference-pp-tp-8-canary
alex: will post nvprof link + prometheus dashboards when runs finish. tagging @eng-runtime @eng-oncall for visibility.
maria: :thumbsup:
alex: initial nvprof uploaded: https://perf.redwood/nvprof/9a8b/trace.nvprof. Next step is diff against baseline trace using `tools/trace_diff --compare baseline/9a7f`.
kai: good. if diff shows sustained `allreduce_queue_ns` per-step increase, revert selector or choose `overlap` preference until we rework the kernel latency profile.
alex: noted. I'll also run a microbenchmark that pins only one layer to `fused_ffn_v2` to quantify per-layer impact.
